August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 187)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on August 26 across American and South African radio, four profound docudramas of The Eternal Light produced by the Jewish Theological Seminary on NBC (Joseph in Egypt, Human Equality, Wilderness of Sinai, and Universal Public Education), Victor Jory starring in Liam O'Flaherty's The Informer on The New Theater, and Peter Copley solving Green for Danger on Thirty-Three Half Moon Street (1945–1965):
